title: Curated usage ledger line
description: One line of <store>/usage.jsonl, the curated store's append-only usage ledger: every view, save, edit, forget and helped or harmed sighting of a memory, by name; the index ranks memories by it. It also keeps docs/brain-memory.md decision 2's gate on changes to shared memory: a forget or edit staged in its own session, and a layer forget or rollback, confirmed on a user's words or staged, under the name layer:<kind>/<name> or layer:rollback (curated.LayerKey, LayerRollbackKey). Source: memory/curated/store.go (usageLine, appendUsage, Usage, the Event constants) and memory/curated/gate.go.

quote.description: A helped or harmed event's evidence, the user's words a forget retired the memory on, an edit or a layer forget or rollback was made on for every session (at most curated.MaxForgetsPerQuote of these per quote), or the user's words a released event restated a held memory with.

user.description: A helped, forget, edit, layer-forget, layer-rollback or released event whose quote is a user's words.

record.description: The record a corrected, cited or promoted event names, or a layer rollback's target generation.

session.description: The session of a staging (the save or staged event of a staged memory), of a forget-staged event, which hides the memory in that session only, of an edit-staged event, which changes it in that session only, of a layer change, or of a released event, which shows a held memory (one that weakens security, contracts/insecure.md) in that session only.

model.description: The model whose layer a layer-forget, layer-forget-staged, layer-rollback or layer-rollback-staged event acts on.

revision.description: An edit-staged event's content: the memory's type, description and body as the edit left them in its session (curated.PendingRevision), redacted.

source.description: A staging's source digest: sha256 hex of the tool output its quote comes from, whitespace collapsed (curated.SourceDigest); two sessions' stagings are independent evidence only when their digests differ.
